### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **8** documentable anchor(s).

**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`  _(via ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND (literal, a string literal in registerShareLinkRoutes))_
- `content/docs/deployment/production-readiness.mdx`  _(via createDispatcherPlugin (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`  _(via createDispatcherPlugin (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/share-links/* (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND (literal, a string literal in registerShareLinkRoutes))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **31** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 265ef64ba7047919460862c4e798cd5651dd92a7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `08633dbbdd493ca31f6e5e87745acef4688e0e9f` — the merge of head `99ce467e329cdb345754db0a90704214148dacc1` into base `265ef64ba7047919460862c4e798cd5651dd92a7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 08633dbbdd493ca31f6e5e87745acef4688e0e9f && git checkout 08633dbbdd493ca31f6e5e87745acef4688e0e9f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 265ef64ba7047919460862c4e798cd5651dd92a7 99ce467e329cdb345754db0a90704214148dacc1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 265ef64ba7047919460862c4e798cd5651dd92a7 && git merge --no-ff 99ce467e329cdb345754db0a90704214148dacc1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 265ef64ba7047919460862c4e798cd5651dd92a7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 265ef64ba7047919460862c4e798cd5651dd92a7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:cli` seat 1 · `os-sales` · session `session_01BVm1pAXVXQ3PjC42j1kPFf` · 2026-10-17T04:56Z

Head `99ce467e3`. This is the seat's review of record for #24024 (claim `6228915137`), read against GitHub and `origin/main`, ⛔ not against the report.

- **Form:** draft → `main`, assignee `os-sales`. The first line is `Fixes #24024`, the body's only closing keyword (scanned). `Clause-②: no` is line-initial and matches the claim.
- **No accept set moves, read in the code:**
  - The door's new floor asks `shouldDenyAnonymous` (`packages/core/src/security/anonymous-deny.ts` on `origin/main`). For these routes that is the same decision as the removed `Boolean(ctx.userId)`; only a CORS preflight differs, and the family mounts no OPTIONS route.
  - Both token routes carry `publicRoute: true` on the head (`share-link-routes.ts` `:422`-`:423`, `:597`-`:598`), so the floor skips them, as the claim's hold-off on the open and visit doors requires.
  - The catch-all `${base}/*` is registered last, so the five routes keep every request they serve.
  - Every new mount answers a request the server refused before (`405` or `404` from the adapter) with another refusal (`401`, or the domain's `404` / `501`). `Clause-②: no` stands.
- **The shared answer, not a re-spelling:** the 401 uses `ANONYMOUS_DENY_STATUS`, `ANONYMOUS_DENY_CODE` and `ANONYMOUS_DENY_MESSAGE` from `@objectstack/core`, which `plugin-sharing` already depends on (`workspace:*`). No error code is minted. `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` is an existing code. The `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` alternative would have been a `packages/spec` ledger edit, correctly held off.
- **The owner choice:** plugin-side for `/share-links`, by measurement. The dispatcher registers in `start()`, before `plugin-sharing` mounts at `kernel:ready`, so a dispatcher wildcard would have taken the token routes. No route owner or published path changes.
- **Ledger:** 12 exact `server-only` rows for the notifications verbs, plus one `* /share-links/**` family row; the census moves 92 → 105.
  - That is the inherited ruling `6222005517` answer 1, letter A, applied with its reason. The wildcard is justified where the reason did not reach: "every path the domain does not serve" is a sub-path claim.
- **Surface:** 12 files. 9 are inside the claim. 3 are forced, derived co-changes, accepted as such: `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` docblock 92 → 105, `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` 92 → 105, and `error-status-unpinned-baseline.json`, which drops its `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` row (shrink-only, because the catch-all now declares its 404).
- **The open question, answered by the seat: A, keep exact rows on `/notifications`.** The published text promises "every face" for `/notifications`, and adds "every path the domain does not serve" only for `/share-links`. A sub-path no face names is not a face, and that is the reading `/keys` got under `6222005517`. There is no change in this PR and no ruling owed.
- **PM assumption 3, partly falsified, accepted:** a signed-in caller of a new notifications mount gets the domain's `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` (or `501` with no inbox), not a `405`. It is still refused.
- **Changeset** (`@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` patches), against the diff:
  - "anonymous … `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, … `httpStatus: 401`": the shared constants. ✓
  - "except `GET /share-links/:token/resolve` and `GET /share-links/:token/messages`": `publicRoute`. ✓
  - "`404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, naming the request": `notServed`. ✓
  - "Every request that was served is served as before": registration order and the token flags. ✓
  - "A notifications sub-path no face names … is answered `404`": exact paths only. ✓
  - The signed-in notifications answer ("`404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` … or the `501`") is the domain's, read from the report's measurement. The seat did not re-measure it.
- **Tests:** 4 ablations, all red as predicted. Notifications mounts: 26 failed; door floor: 20 failed; catch-all, unit leg: the 2 census pins; catch-all, dist leg: 29 failed after a rebuild with the preflight. Every restore is proven by blob and by an empty `git diff HEAD`. The 5 dogfood suites read 212/212 on the head; `route-ledger-live-mount-parity` is among them.
- **Out of scope, one line each:**
  - the anonymous unparseable-body `400` ahead of the `401` floor on the standalone mounts: filed #24151, the family's closing card (20 sites enumerated);
  - the PUT and PATCH mounts outside the observability Proxy: carrier #24025;
  - the 405 with no `Allow` header: carrier #24023 (this PR adds no 405);
  - the signed-in 404 spelled three ways across hosts: Acceptance notes, no carrier.
- **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 24149`: 0 of 12 paths, 911 lines ≤ 3000). At this record, `Lint & Repo Gates` is success, while `TypeScript Type Check` and the six `Test Core` shards are still running. The PR goes ready with auto-merge armed once every check on the head is green.
